__comment: Pine tree — fast-growing evergreen, the primary source of basic construction lumber.
No fruit. Used for structural beams, flooring, and simple furniture.
Evergreen: only two season keys (summer baseline, winter snow-laden).
Missing season keys fall back to 'summer' at runtime.
Fastest-growing tree in the roster; early-game wood supply.
Three growth stages: sapling → mature → ancient.
summer x3, winter x2. Sapling stays single.
Variants differ in: silhouette taper angle, branch length, trunk lean (subtle).
All variants must have the same XZ footprint and trunk base position.

__placement_comment: World-gen scatter rules read by SurfaceFloraSpawner (data, not logic).
Pine is the elevation tree: foothill + mountain domains only, never lowland.
Density by terrain surface Y (in blocks), per WorldGenerator's bands:
- min_surface_y .. full_density_max_y : full density (foothill shelf + lower mountain)
- full_density_max_y .. falloff_max_y : density ramps linearly to zero (the treeline band)
- >= falloff_max_y                    : no pines (bare rock / future snow cap)
Reference bands (WorldGenerator.gd): foothill shelf Y20-43, mountain Y44-115.
Determinism (Hard Rule 8): every decision derives from world_seed + column XZ.
footprint = XZ block extents per stage; spacing and collision use these.
scatter_cell_size = grid cell (blocks) holding at most one tree, jittered within the cell.
spawn_chance = probability a full-density cell contains a pine (before falloff scaling).
max_surface_slope = reject a footprint whose columns differ in surface Y by more than this.
edge_margin = ring (blocks) around the footprint checked for drops; 0 disables.
edge_dropoff_max = reject if a ring column is off-world or drops more than this below the trunk (keeps canopies off cliff lips / the world edge).
